themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, make decisions, and take actions within a research context.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to condense and extract key information from large volumes of text or data.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, enhancing productivity.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Details how AI is being applied to product discovery, development, roadmap planning, and feature prioritization.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing jobs, skills requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers AI applications in evaluating the ease of use and effectiveness of products and systems.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on using AI to analyze customer data and behavior to derive actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated personas or user simulations for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI-assisted recruitment
themes.description: Articles related to AI tools and techniques used to streamline and improve the hiring process.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
